title: McMoneagle's Pentagon remote viewing of a UFO above a nuclear missile

tellings.quote: the story is that he basically saw a UFO hovering over a nuclear missile

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle, working at the Pentagon, is said to have used remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places with the mind alone, and seen a UFO hovering over a nuclear missile. Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFOs at nuclear bases, passes this on from McMoneagle. If true, it would add to claims that UFOs watch nuclear weapons.
